$comment: Dutch typography. macOS Dutch quotes UI names in single quotes (385 single-quoted values across live Finder + AppKit nl.lproj, one curly ‘^1’ in Finder's LocalizableMerged, zero double; verified on macOS 26.6.2, plutil over *.strings, 2026-09-25), so ‘…’ is primary and “…” nested, per Onze Taal. The apostrophe is written straight (foto's, 's avonds, like Apple's Programma's) or curly. Schema: docs/i18n/termbase.md § <tag>/mechanics.json schema.

spacing.why: a straight ' opening a quotation; quote with ‘…’ (the elided 's, 't, 'n, 'k stay)
no space before % (50%), per the Microsoft Dutch style guide

hedges.why: a bracketed ending (bestand(en), nieuw(e), foto('s)); use ICU plural, or rephrase
a slashed ending (bestand/en, foto/'s); use ICU plural, or rephrase (a unit like bestanden/s is fine)
a hedged article (de/het): name the type first (‘de map {name}’) or use a colon form
de/het in front of an insert that is the whole noun guesses its gender (a file is het, a folder de): name the type first (de map {name}) or drop the article
a hedged pronoun (hij/het, die/dat) for an insert of unknown gender or number: repeat the noun, or use a pronominal adverb (er, daar … mee)
a hedged verb number (is/zijn): pull the noun and its verb into ICU plural branches
an apostrophe-s on an insert depends on how the value ends (Anna's vs Cmdrs): use van ({name} → de inhoud van {name}) or restructure
